fullContentHtml:
EMRS Teaching & Non-Teaching Tier-II Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Ek Lavya Model Residential School (EMRS) NESTS has released the Tier-II Result for the post of Principal, TGT, PGT, Female Staff Nurse, Hostel Warden, Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) and Lab Attendant. This recruitment was issued for 7267 posts. Online applying process for EMRS Teaching & Non-Teaching Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 19 September 2025 to 28 October 2025. The Tier-II examination was conducted on 22 to 25 March 2026. Candidates who have appeared for this examination can download their EMRS Teaching & Non-Teaching Tier-II Result 2026 from the link provided below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 19 September 2025
  • Last Date : 28 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 October 2025
  • Exam Date : 13, 14 & 21 December 2025
  • Exam City Details : 28 November 2025
  • Admit Card : 11 December 2025
  • Answer Key : 05 December 2026
  • Result : 31 January 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 04 February 2026 Available
  • Tier-II Exam Date : 22 March to 25 March 2026
  • Tier-II Exam City Details : 03 March 2026
  • Tier-II Admit Card : 19 March 2026
  • Tier-II Answer Key : 13 May 2026
  • Tier-II Result : 03 September 2026

Application Fee

  • Principal Post
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 2500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 500/-
  • TGT, PGT Post
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 2000/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 500/-
  • Non Teaching Post
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs.1500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
